compliance.intro_text: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period expires 14 days after the day on which you, or a third party other than the carrier indicated by you, acquire physical possession of the goods; for several goods ordered together but delivered separately, of the last of them. To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us of your decision by an unequivocal statement, for example with the form on this page or by letter or email to the contact details shown on this website. To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient to send your communication before the withdrawal period has expired. You must send back the goods without undue delay and in any event not later than 14 days from the day on which you inform us of your withdrawal. You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling other than what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.
compliance.excluded_products_text: The right of withdrawal does not apply to: goods made to your specifications or clearly personalised; goods that are liable to deteriorate or expire rapidly; sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health protection or hygiene reasons, once unsealed after delivery; sealed audio or video recordings or computer software, once unsealed after delivery; newspapers, periodicals and magazines, except subscription contracts. For digital content not supplied on a tangible medium, the right of withdrawal is lost only once supply has begun with your prior express consent and your acknowledgement that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal.
compliance.return_shipping_text: We bear the cost of returning the goods.
compliance.refund_policy_text: We will refund all payments received from you without undue delay and in any event not later than 14 days from the day on which we receive your withdrawal notice. We use the same means of payment as you used for the original transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of the refund. We may withhold the refund until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earlier.
